notes:
Moagram 13.2.2 preview 5

- Notifications now arrive through Google's push service, like regular Telegram. Moagram no longer needs its always-on background connection, so Android can close it when you are not using it. This greatly reduces battery drain, phone heating and memory use.
- On phones without Google Play services, Moagram can use a UnifiedPush app such as ntfy instead. Without either, it keeps using the background connection as before.
- New Settings -> Moagram Settings -> Push Notifications row shows how notifications are delivered and lets you switch back to the background connection.

Android 6.0 or later. Install over your existing Moagram app to keep accounts and settings.
critical_message: This update moves notifications to Google's push service, which greatly reduces battery drain and phone heating. Please install it.
